# Trashpad / 휴지패드 / 消えるメモ / 废纸便签

> A scratch pad that deletes itself. Type and it stays; each note is deleted once its timer runs out, counted from the last edit. There is no Save button and no archive.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://trashpad.try-dabble.com/
All data stays in the browser (localStorage keys trashpad:notes:v1 and trashpad:default-ttl:v1). No accounts, no subscription, no server-side storage, no sharing.

This is NOT a burn-after-reading link service like privnote, and it does NOT lose your notes when the tab closes.

## Pages

- [Home](https://trashpad.try-dabble.com/): Write notes, pick the delete timer, watch the countdown
- [Privacy](https://trashpad.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://trashpad.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/trashpad): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Auto-save as you type. There is no Save button anywhere.
- Per-note delete timer and a default for new notes: 1h / 6h / 24h / 48h / 7d
- Default is 24 hours measured from the LAST EDIT; editing a note restarts its countdown
- Live countdown stamp on every note, plus a one-tap timer restart
- Expired notes are deleted on load and while the app is open. No archive, no undo.
- Notes survive closing the tab or the browser, until their timer expires
- No account, no login, no subscription, no cloud sync, no share links
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
